description: This file defines an abstract class 'StatefulTask' that extends 'AbstractTask' within the OpenMRS scheduler module. It manages a private 'Context' instance representing some internal state, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: StatefulTask
classes.description: An abstract class representing a task with internal state, extending AbstractTask and managing a Context object.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the context for this task.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context associated with this task.
